author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: design review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. The user asks for a thorough review of this spec from every angle. Packet kind: a design for a service that renders customer receipts as PDFs, emails them, and offers a self-serve download page. Context: peak traffic and a latency budget, a storage and email cost budget for two years, the company accessibility policy (WCAG 2.2 AA for every customer page and document), the on-call standard (every async job needs an alarm and a dead-letter path), the security standard for customer links. Plant across five different concerns, never two in one subsection: download links use sequential ids with no expiry; the PDF is rendered inside the request path and the given peak numbers break the latency budget; failed email sends have no alarm and no dead-letter path; every PDF is kept forever in hot storage and the given numbers pass the year-two budget; the download page shows status by colour only and the PDF is an image with no text layer; one retry loop re-sends email with no limit so a bounce storm costs money. Write every planted problem the way the team really wrote them: no comment, diff line, test name or doc may say decoy, planted, intentional, on purpose or correct here.
